duel.mdd: I'm betting on your fingers. Think, and you're late.
duel.label.name: Name
duel.aria.name: Name to duel under
duel.status.idle: Make a link and send it over. The duel starts the moment they open it.
duel.status.waiting: Waiting for a rival… send them the link.
duel.status.left: Your rival left. Send the link again to pick it back up.
duel.status.blocked: Still nobody here. If they opened the link and it still looks like this, one of your networks is blocking the direct connection.
duel.status.searching: Looking for a rival… the duel starts as soon as someone shows up.
duel.status.lonely: Nobody yet. Hit “Ghost” and you can play right now on your own.
duel.status.ghost: You are duelling the ghost. When a person shows up, make a link and call them in.
duel.status.finish: {me} : {foe} — the room is still open. Hit “One more” to start again.
duel.copy.shared: Link copied — send it and you are connected
